evals.name: unsupported-agent-frontmatter
evals.subject: static-validation
evals.prompt: Validate the custom agent file at assets/evaluation-fixtures/invalid-agent.md. Report every unsupported frontmatter field and do not rewrite or install the fixture.
preconditions: Only name, description, and model are supported frontmatter fields
assertions: Reports tools and permissionMode as unsupported frontmatter fields
Does not modify or install the invalid fixture
evals.expected_output: A deterministic validation failure naming both unsupported fields.

evals.name: create-evidence-focused-reviewer
evals.subject: new-agent-creation
evals.prompt: Create a project-scoped Goose custom agent named dependency-reviewer in the assigned sandbox. It reviews dependency updates for supply-chain and compatibility risk, uses only supported frontmatter, avoids claiming unavailable tools, validates before installation, and includes a concrete invocation example.
preconditions: Write only in the assigned sandbox
Validate a staging file before copying it into the project discovery path
Do not mutate live user agent directories
assertions: Creates a role-focused dependency-reviewer Markdown definition
Uses only name description and optional model frontmatter
Validates the definition before installing it into the project path
Reports the installed path validation evidence and invocation example
evals.expected_output: A validated project agent definition with evidence and no unsupported runtime configuration.

evals.name: paired-security-role-comparison
evals.subject: agent-behavioral-evaluation
evals.prompt: Compare the custom agent at assets/evaluation-fixtures/role-comparison/current/security-reviewer.md with the baseline at assets/evaluation-fixtures/role-comparison/baseline/security-reviewer.md using assets/evaluation-fixtures/role-comparison/evals.json. Run paired delegated tasks with equivalent controller settings, grade every assertion, aggregate a benchmark, generate a static review, and report whether the current role improves without inventing vulnerabilities.
preconditions: Copy immutable agent fixtures into isolated temporary projects
Use the same model, tools, task inputs, and budget for both configurations
assertions: Runs paired current and baseline delegated executions for every case
Produces grading and benchmark artifacts with evidence
Generates a static qualitative review artifact
Reports both improvement and false-positive restraint without relying on static validation
evals.expected_output: A complete paired custom-agent evaluation with traceable artifacts and conclusion.

evals.name: agent-versus-workflow-boundary
evals.subject: scope-routing
evals.prompt: Un utilisateur demande un assistant réutilisable qui exécute chaque lundi une séquence planifiée avec paramètres, extensions et notifications. Explique si cela doit devenir un custom agent Goose, une recipe ou un plugin. Ne crée aucun fichier et n’affirme pas avoir installé quoi que ce soit.
preconditions: The answer must preserve the custom-agent format boundary
assertions: Explains that a custom agent represents a reusable role rather than scheduled orchestration
Routes repeatable parameterized steps to a recipe or plugin as appropriate
Does not create or claim installation of an agent file
evals.expected_output: A concise abstraction decision preserving agent, recipe, and plugin boundaries.
